title: 第15章 女人是猛虎第16章 唐诗逸把持不住了
content_zh:
;;
唐诗逸曼妙的身材，散发出一股幽兰的香气。
说话间，身体不小心碰到了陈楚。
纤细柔软、又带着长期锻炼的弹性皮肤，让陈楚实在忍不住。
“哎呦……哎呦……”
好在地上的惨叫，把陈楚从旖旎中拉到了现实中。
刚才唐诗逸的挑逗，让他体内的欢喜鏖战大法差点开启了原始人类的模式。
有一个动画片就讲述原始人类在机场碰见采访的美女记者，忽然就野性大发，扑上去现场直播。
陈楚刚才差点就鲁莽了。
看来没事的时候也要多修行，争取压制住原始的冲动。
汪明海秘书打了个电话，马上来了一队穿制服的警员。
领头的冲汪明海立正敬礼。
“领导，请您指示，这些人怎么处理？”
汪明海冷冷道：“光天化日，抢夺老百姓私有财产，全部开除公职！另外严重的扔进监狱，接受审判！”
“是！”
警员将这群治安员戴上手铐，押解到了车内。
唐诗逸问：“陈楚，那些白菜呢？”
“哦，让管城没收了！”
汪明海怒道：“简直太不像话了！我们直接去管城大队！”
一行人到了管城大队。

汪明海和陈楚、唐诗逸走了进去。
管城几个队员，不断在唐诗逸迷人的凸凹身材打量。
陈楚体内欢喜鏖战功法细嗅蔷薇，听见两个管城队员小声嘀咕着：这娘们真骚啊，要是把她弄到床上，我非搞她三天三夜不可！
另一个管城嘻嘻一笑：没错，我情愿死在她身上……
但见汪明海和陈楚，便马上换了衣服嘴脸。
“喂，那个长得尖嘴猴腮的老登！谁让你进来的？”
“什么？你说谁是老登？”
汪明海简直要气死了。
“就说你呢！老登你知道这是什么地方吗？马上滚出去，要不然老拿电棍电死你！”
“混账！”汪明海气得浑身发抖。
“我擦！你还敢骂人？”
一个管城吹响哨子，马上，十多个管城从办公室跑了出来。
“把这两个闹事的抓起来！狠狠的打！”
管城一拥而上。
陈楚出手了，这些管城平时作威作福，普遍偏胖，真打起来，如果一对一根本不是老百姓对手。

Tang Shiyi's graceful figure exudes the fragrance of orchid.
While talking, his body accidentally touched Chen Chu.
The slender, soft, and elastic skin from long-term training made Chen Chu really unable to bear it.
"Ouch... Ouch..."
Fortunately, the screams on the ground pulled Chen Chu from the charm to reality.
Tang Shiyi's teasing just now made the joy in his body almost activate the primitive human mode.
There is a cartoon about a primitive human being who met a beautiful reporter at the airport and suddenly became wild and jumped on her to broadcast live.
Chen Chu was almost reckless just now.
It seems that you should practice more even when you have nothing to do, and try to suppress your primitive impulses.
Secretary Wang Minghai made a call, and a team of uniformed police officers came immediately.
The leader stood at attention and saluted Wang Minghai.
"Leader, please give me instructions on how to deal with these people?"
Wang Minghai said coldly: "If you rob people's private property in broad daylight, they will all be fired from their public offices! In addition, those who are serious will be thrown into prison and face trial!"
"Yes!"
The police officers handcuffed the security guards and escorted them into the car.
Tang Shiyi asked: "Chen Chu, where are those cabbages?"
"Oh, let Guancheng confiscate it!"
Wang Minghai said angrily: "This is so outrageous! Let's go directly to the city management team!"
A group of people arrived at the city management brigade.
Wang Minghai, Chen Chu, and Tang Shiyi walked in.
Several team members in Guancheng kept looking at Tang Shiyi's charming convex and concave figure.
Chen Chu was sniffing the rose with joy and ferocity, and heard the two city management team members muttering in a low voice: This bitch is so naughty, if I get her on the bed, I will have to fuck her for three days and three nights!
Another Guan Cheng smiled: Yes, I would rather die on her...
But when he saw Wang Minghai and Chen Chu, he immediately changed his clothes and his face.
"Hey, that old man with the sharp mouth and monkey cheeks! Who let you in?"
"What? Who do you think is Lao Deng?"
Wang Minghai was so angry.
"I'm just talking about you! Lao Deng, do you know where this place is? Get out right now, or I'll electrocute you with an electric baton!"
"Bastard!" Wang Minghai was so angry that he was shaking all over.
"I'll wipe it! How dare you curse?"
A Guancheng blew his whistle, and immediately, more than a dozen Guancheng ran out of the office.
"Catch these two troublemakers! Beat them hard!"
Guan Cheng rushed forward.
Chen Chu took action. These Guanchengs were usually domineering and overweight. In a real fight, they were no match for the common people in a one-on-one fight.
